content_zh:
林新也完全没经验，冲她点点头，示意她自己处理。脑子里残留的记忆里，大多都是来踢馆不成的都得留下补偿。不过他第一次遇到这种局面，心头直打鼓，紧张得不行，只能全权由安颖解决了。
最后霍横刀留下所有的兵器，加上身上的十多两银子，才退了出去。
这可是一笔大数目，林新按照记忆里的物价换算了下，银子差不多相当于一万多人民币。而兵器也贵得离谱，虽然总共只有三把刀，但是每把刀的造价不下于七八千人民币。特别是在这种兵器被门派官府管制的环境，更是有价无市。总共一下就是三万多的收入。
等着霍横刀退出去，安颖收起剑，林新这才心头大大松了口气。这时路雨才从房里跑出来，开始收拾地上的兵器和银两，路云也提出桶水开始清理地面的血迹。
林新看着一脸无辜的安颖，这家伙不识字，没什么文化，心智虽然比路云兄妹好，但也有限，看她脸上掩饰不住的爱慕之意就知道，这家伙对他原先的这个身份林新如，早就是情根深种。
林新如出身富商家庭，从小识字读书，加上长相不算差，又把道馆管理得还算可以，衣食无忧，在这种读书识字十分奢侈的年代，那就是真正的高层次人才。
加上长得也还行，家里又有钱，换成现代的说法，那就是标准的高富帅，还加高学历！
“唉.....”想起那个老头临终对他说的话，眼下这个道馆是他当家了，林新忽然对安颖手里明晃晃的剑也没了畏惧心，长叹一口气。
“把身上整理下吧，有什么地方伤到没有？”他问。
安颖顿时脸色一红，有些扭扭捏捏起来。
“有一点点伤.....”
“在哪？我给你看看。”林新算是半个医学专业，吐了口气走上去准备给她看看。
“这个.....”安颖面色越发红了。
“到底是哪啊？”林新无语。但看了眼边上路雨路云有点怪异的眼神，他顿时想起来，这个世界可不是他以前，男女之间的防线要大很多。他这样的举动明显有些不合时宜。
就算是江湖儿女要不拘束一点，这么毫不顾忌也有些唐突了。
“是腿.....”安颖低下头声如蚊蚋，“麻烦大师兄了.....”
“你腿哪伤了？”不过既然已经发话了，他脸颊微红，也索性坚持下去。
安颖默默的转过身来，果然她的大腿后侧有着一道明显的刀伤，奇怪的是伤口很细，而且没有多少血流出来。
“唉....”林新再度叹了口气。忽然感觉自己有点适应这个世界的生活了。
“路雨去拿点药来，给她敷上。”他只能这么安排。

“药...药没有了，只能下山买...”路雨小声回答。
林新这才想起这个时代的医疗技术很差，很多药药效不好保存，只能马上用马上抓。而一些常用的外伤药则是很贵的东西。因为没有流水线批量生产，所以成本很高。
平时这些东西都是他下山回家去取，但现在....他已经不是原来的林新如，而是林新，这叫他怎么回去再见这里的父母双亲？
“这事暂时先等等吧....”林新也粗略的认得几种能治外伤的药草，还有例如蒲公英之类的消炎药。
一番忙碌下，他去山上采了一些自己仅有的能识别的几种药草，捣烂了给安颖敷上。
路云路云照例生火做饭做菜，安颖回屋修炼，林新就有些没事干了。
他找了个地方坐下来，望着已经有些暗淡的天色，心头一阵迷茫。
莫名其妙来到这个地方，他也不知道自己应该做什么。
坐在道馆门口，他望着下方一路延伸下去的灰色石阶，只想就这么安静的坐着，好好休息。
他一巴掌打在自己脖子上，一只血红色的足足有硬币大小的血色蚊子，从他手掌心掉落下来。蚊子已经被他打成一张纸，里面的血都被挤出来。
血点印在他脖子上，感觉有些湿漉漉的。
“嘶....这么大的蚊子....”林新无语，感觉脖子已经有些发肿了。
忽然他眼角看到石阶上隐约浮现一个黑影，正急速朝着道馆跑来。
黑影顺着石阶几步一跨，看起来动作从容，但速度飞快。刚刚才只在视野范围，几个眨眼功夫就到了道馆大门面前。

content_en:
Lin Xin was also completely inexperienced, so he nodded at her and motioned for her to handle it herself. Most of the memories left in my mind are that those who came to play but failed had to leave compensation. But this was the first time he encountered this situation. His heart was pounding and he was so nervous that he had no choice but to leave it to An Ying to solve it.
In the end, Huo Hengdao left all his weapons and more than ten taels of silver with him before retreating.
This was a large amount of money. Lin Xin converted it based on the prices in his memory. The silver was almost equivalent to more than 10,000 yuan. The weapons were also ridiculously expensive. Although there were only three knives in total, each knife cost no less than seven or eight thousand RMB. Especially in this environment where weapons are controlled by the sect's government, they have a price but no market. The total income is more than 30,000 yuan.
After Huo Hengdao retreated and An Ying put away her sword, Lin Xin felt greatly relieved. At this time, Lu Yu ran out of the room and started to collect the weapons and silver on the ground. Lu Yun also brought out a bucket of water and started to clean up the blood stains on the ground.
Lin Xin looked at the innocent-looking An Ying. This guy was illiterate and had no education. Although his mind was better than that of the Lu Yun brothers and sisters, it was still limited. Looking at the unconcealed admiration on her face, he knew that this guy had long been deeply in love with his original identity, Lin Xinru.
Lin Xinru was born into a wealthy businessman family. She had been literate and educated since she was a child. Besides her good looks, she also managed the gym fairly well and had no worries about food and clothing. In this era when education and literacy were very luxurious, she was considered a real high-level talent.
In addition, he looks pretty good and his family is rich. In modern terms, he is a standard tall, rich and handsome man, with a high degree of education!
"Alas..." Thinking of what the old man said to him before his death, and now that he was in charge of this gym, Lin Xin suddenly lost all fear of the sword shining in An Ying's hand and sighed.
"Take care of yourself. Are there any injuries?" he asked.
An Ying's face suddenly turned red and she started to squirm a little.
"It hurts a little bit..."
"Where is it? Let me show you." Lin Xin, who was half a medical major, exhaled and walked up to show her.
"This..." An Ying's face turned redder.
"Where is it?" Lin Xin was speechless. But after looking at the strange look in Lu Yuluyun's eyes, he suddenly remembered that this world was not the same as before, and the line of defense between men and women was much larger. His behavior was obviously inappropriate.
Even if the children of Jianghu were more relaxed, it would be a bit outrageous to be so unscrupulous.
"It's the legs..." An Ying lowered her head and spoke like a gnat, "I'm sorry, Senior Brother..."
"Where is your leg injured?" But now that he had spoken, his cheeks were slightly red, so he simply persisted.
An Ying turned around silently, and sure enough, there was an obvious knife wound on the back of her thigh. The strange thing was that the wound was very thin, and not much blood came out.
"Alas..." Lin Xin sighed again. Suddenly I feel like I have adapted to life in this world.
"Lu Yu is going to get some medicine and apply it on her." This was the only way he could arrange it.
"Medicine...the medicine is gone, so I can only go down the mountain to buy it..." Lu Yu replied softly.
Lin Xin then remembered that the medical technology in this era was very poor. Many medicines were not effective and could not be preserved, so they could only be used immediately. Some commonly used trauma drugs are very expensive. Because there is no assembly line mass production, the cost is very high.
Usually he would go down the mountain to get these things, but now... He is no longer Lin Xinru, but Lin Xin. How can he go back and see his parents here again?
"Let's wait for now..." Lin Xin also roughly recognized several herbs that can treat trauma, as well as anti-inflammatory drugs such as dandelion.
After a lot of work, he went to the mountain to pick some herbs that he could identify, smashed them and applied them to An Ying.
Lu Yunlu YunzhaoFor example, they made a fire to cook, An Ying went back to the house to practice, and Lin Xin had nothing to do.
He found a place to sit down and looked at the already dark sky, feeling confused.
He came to this place out of nowhere and didn't know what he should do.
Sitting at the door of the gym, he looked at the gray stone steps extending all the way down, and just wanted to sit quietly and have a good rest.
He slapped himself on the neck, and a blood-red mosquito the size of a coin fell from the palm of his hand. The mosquito had been beaten into a piece of paper by him, and all the blood inside was squeezed out.
There were blood spots on his neck, which made him feel wet.
"Hiss... such a big mosquito..." Lin Xin was speechless, feeling that his neck was already swollen.
Suddenly, from the corner of his eye, he saw a dark figure vaguely appearing on the stone steps, running towards the gym at a fast speed.
The black shadow took a few steps along the stone steps. He seemed to move calmly, but his speed was very fast. He was only within the field of vision just now, but in a few blinks he was in front of the gym gate.
